limitations: Authored launch timers, not live countdown writes. Apply aboard the ship before launch.
Mission entries sharing a source share a timer, including some cross-faction delta overrides.
The catalogue includes dormant/developer/event variants; presence does not imply current availability.
Names are recovered game text; untranslated or absent text remains explicitly unidentified.
Other runtime modifiers can still alter mission state. No multiplayer replication claim or gameplay validation.
